summary_1line: Ravana battles Yama for seven days until Brahma intervenes, preventing Yama from using the Rod of Death due to the boon granted to Ravana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yama stands in his blazing chariot with the Rod of Death raised high, flames and sparks surrounding the weapon as he prepares to strike Ravana.
Brahma suddenly appears between the combatants, halting Yama mid‑strike as Ravana stands defiant amid a storm of arrows.
The terrified armies of Rakshasas flee as Yama’s thunderous chariot with blood‑red horses charges onto the battlefield beside the figure of Mrityu.
